items.title: Advance Auto Parts stock plummets: Its 'perpetual turnaround story' might not be working
items.summary: Advance Auto Parts (AAP) stock is nosediving after the company's quarterly earnings missed analysts' expectations. D.A. Davidson managing director and senior research analyst Michael Baker explains the rationale behind the stock's downturn.

items.summary: O'Reilly Automotive stock has delivered strong long term returns over the past five years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares now trade at a premium to an internally estimated intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and earnings multiples. O'Reilly Automotive has returned 122.6% over the past five years, which sets a high bar for any further upside from today's valuation. items.title: O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Completes $1.6 Billion Senior Notes Offering
items.summary: O'Reilly Automotive (NasdaqGS: ORLY) has completed several major fixed-income offerings, issuing new senior notes with multi year maturities. The senior notes span multiple years and carry significant principal amounts, adding fresh long term funding to the company's capital structure. The transactions represent a notable update to O'Reilly Automotive's financing mix that investors may want to factor into their view of the stock's risk profile. items.title: Why O'Reilly (ORLY) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of auto parts and accessories retailer O’Reilly Automotive (NASDAQ:ORLY) fell 2.7% in the afternoon session after competitor Advance Auto Parts posted disappointing second-quarter sales, raising concerns about demand across auto-parts retail. According to TipRanks, Advance Auto Parts plunged more than 20% on August 20, 2026 after revenue of $2 billion missed Wall Street’s estimate and comparable store sales fell 0.5%, with the adjusted EPS beat largely supported by tariff refunds.
